component.name: openajazz
component.summary: Control AJAZZ keyboards: lighting, per-key RGB, remaps, macros

description.p: Unofficial control for AJAZZ keyboards without the Windows app. Supports the AK820 Max Plus over the USB cable or the 2.4G dongle.

ul.li: All built-in lighting effects with brightness, speed, direction and colour
Paint your own per-key designs and store them on the keyboard
Remap keys, record macros and change sleep and response settings
Music sync: the keyboard follows whatever is playing
